name: "Oficina Arara" Exhibition Opening
venue: Casa São Roque — Centro de Arte
description: Be among the first to see this massive collective exhibition, "A Conspiração Dos Pássaros," featuring over 200 works. An opening is the best time to feel the buzz and perhaps even meet some of the artists.
longDescription:
The "Oficina Arara" exhibition opening at Casa São Roque — Centro de Arte marks the debut of "A Conspiração Dos Pássaros," a large-scale collective exhibition. This presentation features over 200 individual works, bringing together a diverse array of artistic contributions. The exhibition is a significant undertaking by Oficina Arara, a collective known for its collaborative projects and extensive network within the contemporary art scene.

Attendees at the opening will have the opportunity to view the extensive collection of works for the first time. The atmosphere of an exhibition opening typically involves a social gathering, allowing for informal interaction among visitors and potentially with some of the participating artists. Casa São Roque, a historic building, provides a grand setting for the display of such a substantial body of work.

Admission to the exhibition opening is free of charge, welcoming all members of the public without prior booking. Casa São Roque is located in Porto and is accessible via public transport, with bus stops nearby. Specific details regarding metro or tram connections are not provided, but the venue is within walking distance of some central areas.
